note: Scroll To Top Button is a config-only front-end module. Its entire state is the config object scroll_top_button.settings (keys enabled [string 'on'/'off'], show_on_admin, button_text, button_style [image|link|pill|tab], button_animation [fade|slide|none], button_animation_speed, scroll_distance, scroll_speed). The settings form route scroll_top_button.settings is gated by core 'administer site configuration'; the module ships no permissions, block, plugin or PHP API. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config object on the live site; setup/cleanup/reset restore the shipped config/install defaults explicitly (State is unreliable on this site).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with the scroll_top_button module, which configuration object holds its settings and which key turns the button on? Note anything unusual about that key's value type.
evals.expected_output: All settings live in scroll_top_button.settings. The 'enabled' key turns the button on, and it is a STRING 'on'/'off' (a radios element), not a boolean — the runtime check is == 'on'.

evals.prompt: Using the scroll_top_button module, which config keys control (a) whether the button also appears on admin pages and (b) how far down the page a visitor must scroll before it appears?
evals.expected_output: show_on_admin (boolean, default FALSE) controls whether the button shows on admin routes; scroll_distance (integer pixels, default 100) is how far the user must scroll before the button appears.

evals.prompt: What is the settings form route path for the scroll_top_button module, and which permission is required to reach it?
evals.expected_output: The form is at /admin/config/user-interface/scroll_top_button (route scroll_top_button.settings) and requires the core 'administer site configuration' permission; the module defines no permission of its own.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the scroll_top_button module is configured. Inspect the live configuration and state which button style is selected.
The scroll_top_button module is configured on this site. Inspect the live configuration and state the scroll distance (in pixels) a visitor must scroll before the button appears.
evals.expected_output: scroll_top_button.settings has scroll_distance 250 (and button_text 'Back to top').

evals.prompt: On my Drupal site I installed the scroll_top_button module but the back-to-top button is not showing. Turn it on and make the button read 'To top'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In scroll_top_button.settings, enabled is the string 'on' and button_text is 'To top'.

evals.prompt: Configure the scroll_top_button module on this site to use the 'pill' button style and a scroll-to-top animation speed of 500 milliseconds. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In scroll_top_button.settings, button_style is 'pill' and scroll_speed is 500.
